mobile.mode.select.tip: Tap to select a province, nation, or army. Drag to pan. Hold to issue an order.
mobile.mode.order.tip: Single tap immediately issues an army move or diplomacy context action. Tap Order again to toggle Order Lock.
mobile.mode.order.oneshot.tip: Order 1×: next tap issues an order (like right-click) and returns to Select. Tap Order again to lock.
mobile.mode.order.sticky.tip: Order Lock: every tap keeps issuing orders continuously until you tap Order again or switch mode.
mobile.mode.select.toast: Select mode: tap picks province, country, or army. Hold issues an order.
mobile.mode.order.oneshot.toast: Order 1×: next tap issues an order (like right-click) and returns to Select. Tap again to lock.
mobile.mode.order.sticky.toast: Order Lock: every tap issues orders until switched off. Tap again to return to 1×.
mobile.mode.box.toast: Box mode: drag one finger to box-select divisions. Two fingers move the map.
mobile.mode.pan.toast: Map mode: safe camera navigation — taps never select or issue orders.
mobile.mode.box.tip: Drag with one finger to draw a selection rectangle for divisions. Pinch or drag with two fingers to move the map.
mobile.mode.pan.tip: Safe map navigation lock: taps and holds never select or issue orders while browsing the map.
mobile.override.let_time_run: Nothing is waiting for you. Tap Play to let time run.
mobile.override.map_controls: Drag with one finger to move the map · Pinch to zoom · Two-finger slide to tilt the globe.
mobile.override.army_orders: Tap an army to select · Switch to Order mode or hold a province to march or attack · Use Box mode to select a group.
mobile.override.peace_controls: Tap: claim · Hold / Order mode: release · Drag / Pinch: move map
mobile.override.handbook_subtitle: What every screen is for, what its figures mean and what to do about them.
mobile.override.country_picker_hint: Tap a country on the map, or search for it by name.
mobile.override.army_in_battle: In combat: use Halt to leave battle, or Order tap / Hold the current province to hold a defence.
